# NeoSmith

Use `neosmith/<model>` with VoltAgent's model router.

## Quick start

```ts
import { Agent } from "@voltagent/core";

const agent = new Agent({
  name: "neosmith-agent",
  instructions: "You are a helpful assistant",
  model: "neosmith/neosmith.intelligent-basic",
});
```

## Environment variables

- `NEOSMITH_API_KEY`

## Provider package

`@ai-sdk/openai`

## Default base URL

`https://router.neosmith.ai/v1`

You can override the base URL by setting `NEOSMITH_BASE_URL`.
